Inside the issue

Ideas worth sitting with

Featured essay / Attention

Making space for a wandering mind.

What if the most useful thing a tool could do was give us a little less to do? A meditation on designing for pauses, not just productivity.

Visit the reading room
Field note / Ritual

A slower start to the morning.

A small experiment in meeting the day before meeting your notifications.

Read the note

Leave your phone where it sleeps. Open a window, make a drink, and notice what your attention does when nothing is asking for it. The point is not a perfect routine; it is a little room to choose one.

Object study / Design

The quiet pleasure of one good button.

On tactility, restraint, and the objects that ask us to be present.

Read the study

A good button tells you what happened through touch. Its small resistance, movement and return are a conversation between a person and an object—one that needs no alert.

Perspective / Culture

What if offline wasn’t an escape?

Finding a more generous rhythm between the connected and the tangible.

Read the perspective

Being offline need not be a dramatic departure. It can simply be one texture in a day: a walk, a conversation, a page turned by hand, and then a return to the useful parts of the network.
